t: Teen Mom UK: From First Baby Steps
d: Mia makes a surprise return to Teen Mom UK! Chloe rebels, Sassi struggles back at home and Megan faces her feelings. Shannon and Charlie go house-hunting while Amber sleeps on the streets.
This week Alice rids Nicole of her embarrassing hash tagging, Sketch cleans away Mark's crotch cobwebs and Jay gets busy on Jack's nauseating nick name tat.

As the gang prepares to leave the house, Marnie has to make a decision about Aaron. Gary and Abbie are both happy, but will everyone leave the Shore together, or will love tear them apart.

t: Ink Master: OGs vs. Young Guns
d: Massive murals have teams struggling for composure in the Flash Challenge. The battle for the Ink Master title continues with Japanese Samurai tattoos. A backward hand sparks heated debate.

t: Teen Mom UK: From First Baby Steps
d: Amber jets off on holiday, it's even more bad news for Sassi as she loses her job. Shannon hits a wall and Megan feels lonelier than ever. Chloe forces Jordan to be romantic.
The tattoo parlour receives a visit from Emma who needs Jay's help with her warning sign and Sketch comes to Michael's rescue after his drunken Taylor Swift tatt put him in trouble.
Francesco faces his fears at a comedy night, while Charlotte flies home leaving Kyle in charge. Catia questions Lachie's intentions before a blow-up spills over into the rest of the house.
Hilary Swank gets a lesson in robotics. Ashley Tisdale brings a fan out of a coma. Chamillionaire gets the best seat in the house.
Things get loud for Lost's Evangeline Lily. Extreme fighter Chuck Liddell learns the perils of street racing. Zac Efron points the finger at the wrong man.
